verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an error-monitoring platform, but the pack never mentions regression detection or alerting when a resolved issue recurs in a newer release. The 'Alerts' and 'Issue Status' items are bare page titles with no content, and the release-management CLI text covers creating releases and uploading artifacts, not regression alerts distinct from new-issue alerts.

support.subject: As an SRE, I get alerted when an error that was fixed comes back in a newer release, distinct from ordinary new-issue noise
